name: tubealfred-youtube
description: Fetch YouTube video, channel, transcript, comments, search, and playlist data from inside Claude Desktop. Uses the TubeAlfred API.
long_description:
TubeAlfred exposes 12 YouTube research tools (video details, transcripts, comments + reply threads, channel feeds, search, playlists, URL resolution) through one hosted MCP server. Install this extension, paste your API key, and the tools appear in Claude Desktop's tool list.

Credits: 1 per call for most endpoints. Comment endpoints meter per item: 1 credit per 5 comments, 100-comment minimum per call.

tubealfred_api_key.title: TubeAlfred API key
tubealfred_api_key.description: Create one at https://tubealfred.com/app/api-keys. Live keys start with ta_live_, test keys with ta_test_.
